build_layoutlmv2_tokenizer: build a LayoutLMv2 tokenizer from a vocab file with bounding boxes and word labels for document understanding
tokenize_document_input: tokenize a list of words with corresponding bounding boxes and word-level labels for layout-aware NLP
encode_plus_with_boxes: encode a single sequence of pretokenized words with bounding boxes into input_ids, attention_mask, and bbox
batch_encode_documents: batch encode multiple document examples with words, bounding boxes, and optional word labels for training
pad_encoded_inputs: pad encoded inputs to a maximum length with bounding boxes and labels on the specified side
